findings.title: Datetime ordering cannot be handled by the optimized paginator
findings.body: `OptimizedCursorPaginator` is selected for audit-log queries ordered by `-datetime`, but this implementation applies `math.floor`/`math.ceil` directly to the datetime value. Building cursors for non-empty audit-log pages will raise `TypeError` instead of returning a response. Use datetime-to-cursor conversion equivalent to `DateTimePaginator` or do not use this paginator for datetime ordering.

findings.title: Negative QuerySet slices are not supported by Django
findings.body: This branch passes a negative `start_offset` to a Django QuerySet slice. Django does not support negative indexing or slicing on QuerySets, so a request with a negative cursor offset reaches this branch and raises an exception rather than paginating. The comments claim Django handles these boundaries, but the ORM requires a non-negative slice offset; implement supported reverse pagination or reject the cursor.

findings.title: Existing span-buffer keys still have the old Redis set type
findings.body: This change switches `span-buf:s:*` keys from Redis sets to sorted sets, but buffers written by the previous version can remain alive until their TTL expires. When the new consumer encounters one of those keys, `ZCARD`/`ZUNIONSTORE` (and the Python-side `ZADD`) operate on a set and fail with `WRONGTYPE`, interrupting span ingestion during rollout. Migrate or version existing keys, or otherwise make the type transition safe.
